notes_for_editor: Dates and tower design agree across the three history pages. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page carries its own 1934 and 1953 lines; they were missing from its evidence and are now quoted. The 2025 footings report is the only source on the site today, and it does not say who controls access. Staffing is omitted because no source gives a staffing history. Access level is omitted because no source states one; the hike-in tag is kept in visit. Brief height 9.1 m matches the 30-foot figure.
